methodology: Bounded first-pass screening based on Qur'anic passage and provisional source-location leads; no critical-edition or manuscript collation. Specific earlier passages mentioned only as unverified research leads, not verified source associations. Checked preceding PR #257 and recent PR #258 (Stories/History consolidation) for scope; no overlapping 7:81–85 batch identified in recent PR results.

records.topic: Lot rebukes men approaching men with desire
records.notes: Genesis 19:4–11 depicts threatened assault on visitors, not an equivalent generalized speech; compare later interpretations separately.

records.topic: Lot's townspeople call for expulsion of those seeking purity
records.notes: No precise earlier speech or expulsion demand established; generic hostility toward moral reformers is not a specific parallel.

records.topic: Lot and his household rescued except his wife
records.notes: Genesis 19:15–26 narrates departure and Lot's wife looking back and becoming a pillar of salt; Qur'an does not give that explanation here.
Genesis 19:24–25 describes sulfur and fire from heaven and overthrow of cities; compare the material and scope without treating them as identical.

records.topic: Shuʿayb addresses Midian and demands honest weights and measures
records.notes: Leviticus 19:35–36 and Deuteronomy 25:13–16 contain rules for honest measures; Exodus 2–3 mentions Midian and a priest, but does not attest this Shuʿayb sermon. Identification with Jethro is a later interpretive question.
